body: A pass-through allow rule at PASS_THROUGH_ALLOW_PRIORITY (3,000,000) cancels the Cookie strip, the per-host SET rules AND the gate block for that host in one rule, and needs no host permission because an allow edits nothing. Content-script excludeMatches cannot carry a port ('Invalid port' makes registerContentScripts throw), so localhost:PORT is excluded on every localhost port for the scripts while the network rule stays exact. Real Google sign-in confirmed working through pass-through (accounts.google.com, accounts.youtube.com) on 2026-10-10 via the staging app.
